extracted.name: Oreo-Stuffed Brownies
extracted.description: Brownie mix makes this surprise-inside dessert quick and easy to make!
ingredient_lines: 1 (18.25 ounce) package brownie mix (such as Betty Crocker®)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease 12 muffin cups or line with paper liners.
Mix brownie mix, oil, eggs, and water together in a bowl until smooth. Spoon about 1 tablespoon batter into each muffin cup. Place 1 cookie into each muffin cup and top with more batter.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted in the side of the brownie comes out clean, 20 to 23 minutes.
